messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI started failing on a bunch of inference images after recent dependency updates. Dependabot flagged a CVE in tokenizers and Snyk shows build falls back to source wheels, which fail in our manylinux pipeline. Anyone already triaging?

sam: seeing it too. Error is during pip install: 'no wheel found for tokenizers==0.13.2' so pip tries to compile from source and chokes on the rust toolchain / musl. Tests time out.

devops-bot: [CI] build/redwood/runtime#482 failed — pytest suite failed during image build step. Logs: https://ci.example.internal/builds/482 (truncated)

li: quick idea: tokenizers 0.13.4 has a published fix for the CVE we saw. Options: (A) bump tokenizers -> 0.13.4 and regen poetry.lock, (B) add a pip constraints file that pins tokenizers to 0.13.4 for an emergency unblock, (C) update base image to include rust toolchain so source builds succeed (less ideal).

maya: can transformers stay compatible with 0.13.4? Our stack currently pins transformers==4.34.0 in the pyproject but allows tokenizers ~=0.13.2. I want the minimal-change path to restore CI quickly. :thinking:

pranav: transformers 4.34.0 is compatible with tokenizers 0.13.x — validated locally. Proposal for rollout: 1) emergency constraints PR that pins tokenizers==0.13.4 and re-runs CI, 2) if green, merge + cut hotpatch image, 3) follow up with `poetry lock` regen and full dependency audit so we don't drift. Also we should update the base image to include a stable rust toolchain to avoid future breakage.

sam: for immediate unblock I'll try a constraints-only PR and also add an ephemeral caching job to restore manylinux wheels from our artifact cache (so pip prefers the wheel). If that fails, we'll do the full poetry.lock bump.

li: I'll open the constraints PR. Minimal diff: add constraints.txt and tweak CI to pass `pip install -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt` during the build step. I'll include this snippet in the PR: ```bash
poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o requirements.txt
pip install -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt
```

maya: that sounds good. Immediate unblock via constraints, then schedule a lock regen + QA run. Please also create a short CVE ticket referencing the Snyk finding and include remediation steps and timeline.

pranav: I'll take the base image work (update gpu-inference:ubuntu22.04 to install rustc/cargo and a pinned manylinux build environment). I'll test creating a canary image and run the same CI jobs.

sam: note for release: check starlette/fastapi transitive deps too — we've seen minor API changes across versions cause integration tests to fail. If constraints cause a bump there, we may need small handler fixes.

maya: agreed. Action items: li -> open constraints PR (emergency) + link CVE ticket. pr -> base image + canary. sam -> artifact cache job + smoke test. maya -> coordinate merge window and notify eng-oncall for rollout. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
